description:
Sing, duet, and create music on Smule, a singing platform built to help you grow your voice with confidence. Start by joining free duets and group songs, using vocal effects and studio‑style tools as you practise and shape your sound. Explore more than 15 million songs and a global community of singers at every level.

Smule offers one of the largest karaoke song libraries available, with new tracks added regularly across pop, rock, R&B, country, K‑pop, musicals, and more. Whether you’re singing for fun or working towards becoming a better singer, Smule gives you space to experiment with your voice at your own pace.

With Smule, you can join duets with singers from around the world at no cost, then move into more advanced creations as your confidence grows. A VIP subscription unlocks solo recording, full access to the karaoke song catalogue, and additional ways to start your own performances and share them more widely.

You can also sing recorded duets alongside official tracks from global superstars. Join pre‑recorded duet performances featuring artists like Ed Sheeran, Dua Lipa, Olivia Rodrigo, Disney favourites, and more, so you can learn songs you love and feel part of the music.

As you sing, Smule helps you improve naturally over time. Use pitch guidance, adjust song keys to better fit your vocal range, and experiment with harmonies, layers, and arrangements. Whether you’re practising on your own, joining duets, or creating group songs, Smule supports progress at every stage of your singing journey.

Smule uses studio‑quality audio and vocal effects to support creativity without replacing your unique sound. Enhance recordings with reverb, filters, and other vocal tools, explore optional AI‑powered tools to refine tone and range, and experiment freely while keeping your voice authentic. These tools are designed to help you learn, improve, and gain confidence as you sing.

Smule is a global community of singers in more than 190 countries. Join duets, create group songs, discover new artists and styles, participate in live singing sessions, or share performances when you feel ready. Many singers start by practising and joining duets, then gradually unlock more creative options as their confidence grows.

Smule is built for every kind of singer, from curious first‑timers and casual karaoke fans to aspiring artists developing their voice. There’s no single right way to use Smule. You choose how you practise, how you perform, and how far you want to go.

Smule is more than a karaoke app. It’s a creative platform for learning to sing, practising with purpose, building confidence, and growing through solo recordings, duets, and musical collaboration – powered by smart tools and a supportive global community. Download Smule and start singing today.

Subscription Info
Get unlimited access to Smule’s full karaoke song catalog and sing karaoke solos, duets, groups, or acapella. Subscriptions are available weekly, monthly, or yearly. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account Settings. Subscriptions cannot be canceled during the active period. Unused trial time is forfeited when a subscription starts.

- You can read our privacy policy at www.smule.com/privacy
- Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD
